notes.content:
[b]Main updates:[/b]

1. All cats have animations, please do not shake the cats violently
2. Brand new cat express mode [CatEX]
3. Add a new CatEX achievement

[b]Important information:[/b]

Sorry, we can't test the MAC version of the game due to studio equipment issues, so we can't continue to update the MAC version, we will remove the MAC version alone

notes.title: The new year of the tiger DLC release
notes.content:
Hello everyone~!

It’s time to say a happy new year again. We are very happy to bring you our latest 2022 Year of the Tiger DLC in time~!

Please allow me to give you a grand introduction to the latest DLC
First of all, this DLC is a [b] free [/ b] DLC 👏 (please applaud)

[h3]⭐A new way to play:[/h3]
A small physics game, you need to stack multiple cats of different shapes on top of Arhats, and keep them from falling for a certain period of time to pass the level.
[h3]⭐41 new levels are waiting for you to challenge[/h3]
[h3]⭐We have added two new cats[/h3]
[h3]⭐New BGM：《猫のワルツ》 By ゆうきわたる[/h3]
[h3]The following is a demonstration:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39158519/4fc9cf93dd61c7045b1d8d65bb5622c9be6addf8.gif[/img]

[h3]Important things:[/h3]
We felt very happy when we were making this new game mode, and hope that everyone can get enough happiness while playing.
No cat was injured during the level production process, such as fall injuries, overweight crush injuries, etc.
Wish you all a Merry Christmas and a good luck in the Year of the Tiger (Good luck in the Year of the Cat)

We have added two new cats

notes.title: We updated it again
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we have updated the game ~!! ✿✿ヽ(°▽°)ノ✿

First of all, thank all players who buy and like our games. Thank you for your support this year. We are very happy to see so many players like to play our games. Secondly, thank those players who give us opinions. We will try our best to correct what we can modify ~!!

[H2] our update this time [/ H2]

[list]

[*] we have made the game support more platforms, and now Linux and MAC systems can play our games ~! (however, there may be an error prompt in Linux. We don't know why we can't solve it for the time being, but it will disappear in a moment, so just ignore it.)

[*] we modify annoying error prompt sounds

[*] we have added a new DLC (fee based)

[*] we also added new cat barking sounds

[*] we have also changed some hidden bugs. If you don't find them, they no longer exist

[*] we also added a bundle - box cats puzzle - I want all versions,

[/list]

notes.content:
Hello everyone~!

Here are our updates:
[list]

[*]Added new BGM
[*]Fixed some bugs

Finally, thank all friends who bought our game, please accept our gift for the Year of the Ox, and wish all friends who see this updated record happy new year~!

notes.title: Update for fix A problem with the right mouse button
notes.content:
Hello everyone:
We updated the version. Although the right mouse button bug is not very common, some players reported this bug to us. We decided to fix this bug quickly, so we updated the version.
If anyone have new bugs, please submit them to us and we will fix them as soon as possible~!
Thanks [b]NEKO[/b] again for the feedback~!
